user.title: Build a Phrase Router rule
user.description: Optionally require a label. Every light carrying it (in whichever area this rule applies to) becomes a target - leave this blank to target every light in that area instead.

area_scope.title: Which room does this apply to?
area_scope.description: "Whichever room heard it" uses the area of whatever voice satellite/device the phrase was spoken to - walk into a room and say it, and it targets that room automatically.

wordings.title: Phrases
wordings.description: Comma-separated. "Toggle" is required and is what runs if neither of the others match. "On"/"Off" are optional explicit wordings.

name.title: Name this rule
name.description: Suggested from the label and room you picked - type your own if you'd rather.

error.toggle_required: Enter at least one toggle wording.
